content.title: Saint Louis beats SIUE 3-0 as Royle fires shutout
content.text: Saint Louis University pitcher Isabel Royal tossed a three-hitter in he Billikens' 3-0 win over SIUE Wednesday at the Billikens Sports Center.SLU AthleticsST. LOUIS – Saint Louis University's Isabel Royle tossed a three-hit shutout, Scout Gallagher and Kate Proffitt had an RBI apiece, and the Billikens defeated SIUE 3-0 Wednesday at the Billiken Sports Center.The shutout was the second in succession and fourth of the season for the Billikens, who improved to 11-15 with their third consecutive victory.Article continues below this adGet Digital Access and Stay Informed With Trusted Local News.Get Digital Access and Stay Informed With Trusted Local News.ONLY 25¢Royle, who evened her record at 5-5, recorded her first shutout of 2026 and the sixth of her career.Saint Louis U. scored the only run it needed in the fourth inning. Anna Christ smacked a one-out double, pinch runner Allie Branstetter moved to third on Ava Wombles' fielder's choice, and Proffitt delivered a sacrifice fly.The Billikens added two insurance runs in the sixth. Bella Stephens led off with a single, advanced to third on a wild pitch and a groundout and scored on Gallagher's groundout. Proffitt and Sophia Boente followed with a double and a single, respectively, and Proffitt scored on a wild pitch.With the tying run on deck for SIUE and one out in the seventh, Billikens center fielder Karsen Jany ran down a deep fly ball and doubled off the SIUE runner at first base to end the game.Article continues below this adSaint Louis U. improved to 11-15 overall while the Cougars dropped to 13-14.Isabel Royle, 5 for 5, went the distance for SLU and was the winning pitcher. Mia Volpert, also 5 for 5, tossed four innings and took the loss.The Cougars picked up hits from Ashley Duran, Betsy Woodward and Juztyne Torres. Woodward now has a seven-game hitting streak and has reached base in each of the last 11 games for SIUE.Article continues below this adSIUE returns to Cougar Field this weekend for the resumption of Ohio Valley Conference play. The Cougars entertain Eastern Illinois for a three-game series. Saturday's doubleheader starts at noon and Sunday's single game also is set for noon.SLU travels to Chicago for a three-game A-10 series with Loyola Chicago.
